During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a '''government''' ruled the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Giju/Legends|Giju]]. However, the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] governing body capitulated and decided to collaborate with the Empire rather than resist.

One Herglic, [[Kelric (Herglic)|Kelric]], a former [[Police officer/Legends|policeman]] on Giju, resigned from his post after the Imperial takeover.
